_comment: Private DN2 audio inputs (firmware-derived, never committed). Rebuilt from the .syx alone with `mise run ready-dn2` (tools/ready_dn2.py): CF cold boot plus a DSP cold-start state attached at idle (SLC-configured TX2932 card, docs/findings/14). The earlier snapshots/dn2-audio-ready-2026-10-06 (and -10-03, which needs DIGI_CARD_IDENTITY=mlc4g) hold a DSP state whose DC-blocker coefficient was corrupted by the pre-ed02999 SIMD Type 17 bug. Files: digi-audio-dn2-image.bin, digi-audio-m5.snap, digi-audio-m5.snap.dsp.
